messages:
Sam (Sales): Pelican Health flagged a midterm renewal — they'd like to move to a 6mo commit and want a blended uplift/discount. Can deal desk weigh in?
Maya (CSM): they hit sustained 1.2B tokens/mo over the last 2 months, embeddings ~42% of calls. Also had a 4h outage in Jan that affected throughput; they're asking for an onboarding credit.
Lisa - Deal Desk: what's the target ARR/commit? Need commit units to price tiers.
Sam (Sales): asking for 600M tokens/month commit (6mo) with 15% discount off list rate; wants onboarding credit equivalent to 1 month of commit.
Arjun (Pricing): 15% on that volume is pretty far from standard. We can offer 10% + 1-month onboarding credit if they sign before EOM. 15% needs Anna/exec approval.
Maya (CSM): note: security questionnaire flagged 'encryption at rest' and request for a private-hosting option. They may require Redwood Private or Dedicated for PHI.
SecEng Bot: Pelican questionnaire id PQ-884. Requires KMS + SOC2 addendum. Private deployment possible but adds ~20% license delta and longer lead time.
Ash (Legal): if we agree to onboarding credit, record as one-time PRR credit in the amendment. They also requested 30d payment terms — legal prefers 45d for enterprise amendments.
Lisa - Deal Desk: can Anna approve the 15% and 30d? @Anna (Sales Ops) please weigh in.
Anna (Sales Ops): we can approve 15% for a 6mo commit but require exec signoff if net MRR impact > $100k. For payment terms, default 45d; 30d needs exec OK.
Sam (Sales): what about Private cost delta? Pelican is in healthcare and wants HSM/KMS options.
Arjun (Pricing): Private delta estimate: +20% infra premium + one-time setup fee $25k. If we fold setup into the commit we can amortize and reduce upfront.
Maya (CSM): customer wants go-live by May 1. If we require Private, delivery likely mid-May. They prefer earlier.
Lisa - Deal Desk: propose consolidated offer: 6mo commit @ 600M/mo, 15% discount, 1-month onboarding credit, payment terms 45d, and a $10k setup credit toward Private. Needs exec sign-off + legal amendment.
Sam (Sales): I'll loop in exec and request a deal-desk approval ticket. Will update account thread after DD ticket.
Anna (Sales Ops): noted. I'll open DD-4527 and tag @Anna and @Ash for signoff.
Maya (CSM): ping me when DD ticket has docs; I'll prep SOW and timeline.
Sam (Sales): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
